villageHall.name: Village Hall
villageHall.description: The Village Hall allows you to purchase town structures and provides your kingdom with 500 gold per day.

townHall.name: Town Hall
townHall.description: The Town Hall allows you to purchase town structures and provides your kingdom with 1000 gold per day.

cityHall.name: City Hall
cityHall.description: The City Hall allows you to purchase town structures and provides your with kingdom 2000 gold per day.

capitol.name: Capitol
capitol.description: The Capitol provides your kingdom with 4000 gold per day.

fort.name: Fort
fort.description: The Fort adds defensive walls to your town.

citadel.name: Citadel
citadel.description: Including a 50% increase to base creature growth, the Citadel adds a keep and a moat to a town's defenses.

castle.name: Castle
castle.description: The Castle adds two arrow towers, fortifies your town's defenses, and doubles base creature growth.

tavern.name: Tavern
tavern.description: The Tavern increases morale for troops defending the city by +1.

blacksmith.name: Blacksmith
blacksmith.description: The Blacksmith supplies your armies with First Aid Tents.

marketplace.name: Marketplace
marketplace.description: With the Marketplace, you can buy and sell resources (exchange rates improve with each Marketplace you own).

resourceSilo.name: Resource Silo
resourceSilo.description: The Resource Silo provides you with an additional +1 wood and +1 ore each day.

shipyard.name: Shipyard
shipyard.description: The Shipyard allows you to purchase ships.

ship.name: Shipyard
ship.description: The Shipyard allows you to purchase ships.

special1.name: Fair
special1.description: The Fair improves the market rate of the Marketplace.

special2.name: Sieidi of Runes
special2.description: The Sieidi of Runes allows local heroes to learn the Basic Runes secondary skill.

configuration.onVisitedMessage: Your hero has already mastered the lore of the Runes.

rewards.message: Do you want your hero to master the lore of the Runes?

onEmpty.message: Your hero attempts to master the lore of the Runes in vain. Already possessing many skills, your hero is unable to learn anything new.
Your hero attempts to master the lore of the Runes before realizing they are unable to read them. It appears as though this art is only accessible to locals and competent scholars.

special3.name: Altar of the Runes
special3.description: The Altar of the Runes adds 1 Rune Level to the player's units at the beginning of combat.

horde1.name: Hay Bins
horde1.description: The Hay Bins increase Mammoth production by 1 per week.

horde1Upgr.name: Hay Bins
horde1Upgr.description: The Hay Bins increases Mammoth and War Mammoth production by 1 per week.

grail.name: Spirits of the Forebears
grail.description: The Spirits of the Forebears increase weekly creature generation by 50%, provide your kingdom with an additional 5000 gold each day, and increase the Defence strength of a garrison hero by +20 when defending against a siege.
